detail: round 1: the draft keyed authority on the transport, which contradicted the shipped Pod skill and its frozen scenario — a mission brief is consumed from mail, so the artifact named as the decision channel travelled on the channel declared never to carry one

round 2: no scenario covered the act that delivers a brief, so the whole suite remained satisfiable by the superseded keying; and every decision scenario ended in a refusal, so a unit that refused every ratification-class action forever passed the suite

round 3: the suite rested on a fact no artifact defined — where a unit learns who may order it — and the standing-delegation bullet invented a leash schema the mechanism does not carry, which also narrowed a frozen sibling scenario
round 4: attenuation was asserted in three artifacts and exercised by no scenario that could fail a config lacking it, and the subagent rules covered only the refusal direction

the Council rejected the round-4 fix: the scenario it added asserted a fact invisible to its own subject — a unit refusing a form-complete decision because the relayer held no authority of that class, which the unit cannot observe. Attenuation is sender-side discipline; the scenario was deleted and the limit stated instead

the Council corrected the framing three times: sending a brief is one act with two shapes, so its arrival in mail is the act working rather than a counterexample; the act constitutes the position, so no owner field was ever needed; and the index files still described the node by both superseded keyings

impl gate withheld the pass: the governance skill reproduced the frozen suite step verbatim as its motivating illustration, so a config could satisfy that scenario by quoting its own test vector. The illustration is now stated in the skill own words, and a swept check finds no verbatim test string left in any shipped file. Every one of the 49 scenarios passed on the merits in the same run.
